claim: Patchline provides backward-compatible certificate migration from PLCI/0 to PLCI/1. The gate loads real legacy certificate bytes whose evidence points at this repository, verifies legacy canonical hashes, maps the old risk-class field into PLCI/1 risk-bps, re-renders canonical PLCI/1 certificates, rechecks file digests and verdict semantics with the current parser, covers safe, guarded, blocked, and unsupported verdict classes, and rejects legacy negative controls. This proves old proof-carrying verdicts remain checkable across schema revisions through `make certificate-migration-gate` rather than being trusted by compatibility folklore.
